overview_description.description:
Marker is a venture capital and growth equity firm with an exceptional track record and a truly global perspective.  The company's mission is to help promising companies develop into great companies and great companies into enduring market leaders.  Their mandate is to partner with dynamic management teams and invest in businesses with high growth and market leadership potential.

Marker was established in 2011 and is headquartered in New York, United States.
